# @canopy/client

The Canopy client SDK: a document cache with live queries, reconnection, resume and resync over canopy.v1.

Works in browsers, React Native, Node, Bun and Deno. Queries use MongoDB syntax and run both on the server and in the client, so optimistic writes show up at once.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/client
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { createClient } from "@canopy/client"

const canopy = createClient({
  url: "https://api.example.com",
  publishableKey: "pk_app",
  auth: { getToken },
})

const stop = canopy
  .from("todos")
  .find({ done: false })
  .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
  .limit(50)
  .subscribe(({ data, status }) => render(data, status))
await canopy.insert("todos", { title: "Write docs", done: false })
```
